prompt:
You are looking at a BEOL SEM defect image pair (brightfield + darkfield) of the same site, imaged at an angle normal to the wafer surface. Bright regions in both images are SiO substrate with a relatively uniform, bumpy texture. Dark regions are etched comparator structures (line trenches, vias, or wide vias) whose long dimensions all run parallel to each other; positioning may be regular or irregular. A comparator's boundary, if covered by a defect, can be inferred from its own regular shape or neighboring comparators. Do not comment on brightness/contrast of the defect or comparators, or on comparator color/darkness -- these are constant properties of this imaging modality, not meaningful observations.

One or more material defects (residual material) may rest on the SiO surface, inside a comparator, or both. Look carefully for more than one distinct defect -- a single fused, multi-lobed blob may actually be several particles merged together; still give your best defect_count regardless.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: strict JSON only, no text outside the JSON object. Use exactly these keys in this order:
coarse_shape -- answer must be exactly one of these four words: circle, round, angular, clumped. circle only for a smooth, symmetric outline with no facet or notch anywhere on the boundary; prefer round/angular if unsure; angular needs at least one relatively straight edge or corner; clumped only for one fused/multi-lobed outline, not just defect_count>1 with separate particles.
shape_elongated (bool -- outline aspect ratio at least 2x approximate length:width)
shape_rounded_corners (bool -- corners are round rather than mostly sharp angles)
shape_jagged (bool -- outline contains sharp angled vertices)
shape_concave (bool -- a noticeable portion of the outline curves inward, departing meaningfully from convex, ignoring minor surface irregularities)
shape_flake (bool -- fragment with an irregular, faceted outline suggesting a broken chip or flake; planar appearance with no significant height/volume impression; prefer true over round/blob-like particles)
coarse_texture (single value, low-to-high relief: smooth, textured, rough)
texture_interior_layer (bool -- a line or contrast boundary within the defect follows the defect's own outline; NOT a comparator edge)
texture_interior_line (bool -- a straight or nearly straight line crossing defect interior even if aligned with an outer edge)
texture_interior_fracture (bool -- a visible, irregular gap/break separating or nearly separating the defect into multiple pieces)
texture_scraggly (bool -- craggy, nodular surface with numerous small knobs/lobes, cauliflower impression)
defect_count (integer, number of distinct material defects visible)
size_percent_of_image (decimal float, your visual estimate of defect area as a percent of total image area)
location_relative -- answer must be exactly one of these four words: on_sio, in_comparator, spanning_both, unclear. on_sio = no touch, or touches without crossing, a comparator's real/inferred boundary. in_comparator = fully within one, with no portion visibly extending onto the SiO surface. spanning_both = edge crosses one comparator boundary, with material present on both sides.
focus_quality (single value: in_focus, out_of_focus, mixed)
confidence (decimal float 0.0-1.0, never a word)
review_required (bool, true if image quality or ambiguity limits assessment)
description (1-2 sentence free-text visual description, excluding brightness/contrast and comparator color commentary)
